question: Using the census data from census.gov, find the Florida counties with less than 50000 residents in the year 2022, that had a GDP less than half a billion (in 2017 chained dollars) in that same year according to the Bureau of Economic Analysis. Exclude counties named after a founding father of the United States from the list by The White House.
